about: The smith's order (VILLAGE_PLAN 3.4, V12): from play session 6, two wood and two coins brought to Domingo at the smithy; he makes the axe and hands it over (smith.delivered, then smith.give_axe in game/host-events.json), and the axe fells a trunk in a quarter of the time. Two coins, not the plan's three: a learner who followed sessions 4 and 5 has two (two from fruit-for-mar, four from oven-wood, four spent on two loaves). Asking in Spanish is the lesson's; walking up with the goods is enough.
